label: Bible Study
prompt: My brethren, count it all _____ when ye fall into divers temptations;
verse: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
note: James opens his letter with the strangest instruction — count trials as joy.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: As far as the east is from the _____, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
verse: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
note: East and west never meet — that's exactly how far God moves our sins away. North and south would've had an end.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he ran before, and climbed up into a _____ tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
verse: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
note: The KJV spells it 'sycomore' — a sturdy fig tree, perfect for a short tax collector named Zacchaeus.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with _____, and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, The LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil.
verse: And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with candles, and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, The LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil.
note: God combs Jerusalem by lamplight for the complacent — 'settled on their lees' is wine left too long on its dregs.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For Ezra had _____ his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.
verse: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.
note: Ezra's order of operations: seek, do, then teach — and first he 'prepared his heart.'
